reviews.author: Tiffany Adams
reviews.text: On, 4/25/26 we needed a tow service due the brakes going out on our Enterprise rental vehicle. We were given the complete run around by Enterprise. Andrew pulled up from Pitt’s Towing and was a life saver. He was so kind and understanding. He called the rental car company and went out of his way to take us to the airport instead of just towing the truck. His kindness and expertise meant the world to us. He is the reason we got there safe. He is the reason my handicap mother did not have to sit in the rain for hours. He is the reminder that there are still good people in this world. We also have to say his girlfriend was just as kind and we appreciated her hospitality as well. Great people that made this tragedy a lot better than what it could have been. Thanks from the bottom of our hearts!!

reviews.author: Nathan Hampton
reviews.text: Excellent towing business. Michael left immediately after I called and had my van on the tow truck less than 5 minutes after arriving where I lost brake power. He also came with a ton of knowledge about how to safely get loaded up with no brakes, even offering advice about how to troubleshoot getting the brakes issue fixed. He not only dropped off the van as quickly as he loaded it, he got my van parked in the exact position it needed to be to have plenty of space to get other vehicles around the driveway. I can't recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Rosa Miller
reviews.text: I could not ask for a better mechanic! As a single female ( who knows nothing about vehicles) I am so grateful to these guys. They are trustworthy, extremely fair in price, prompt and skilled ( and the owner even has a nice, dry sense of humor). I have been taking my vehicle here for years, for inspections, oil changes, and general maintenance. Exceptional service, EVERY single time. Thank you!

reviews.author: Shelly Story
reviews.text: I was out of town on a motorcycle trip when I broke down in a really dangerous area up in the mountains. It could have turned into a nightmare, but a local tow truck driver *Binky*, someone who had helped a friend of mine before, came to my rescue. He went far beyond the call of duty. Not only did he come out to a remote location, but he made sure I was safe and taken care of every step of the way. His professionalism, kindness, and willingness to go the extra mile truly stood out. In a situation where I felt vulnerable and stranded, he showed up with compassion and skill, turning a stressful experience into something I’ll never forget for the right reasons. I honestly couldn’t be more grateful. Highly recommend his services to anyone, you won’t find someone more dependable or dedicated.

reviews.author: Paula Reep
reviews.text: Great trustworthy place to take your vehicle! Been taking my car there for years. They care about your vehicle and you!!! If I could give 10 stars , I would.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Planuchi
reviews.text: told me a different price than what they said when I was getting my car. Very large difference. Terrible.

reviews.author: jessica lea
reviews.text: Ricky came to our rescue and went far above with his customer service. He gave us a ride home and ordered the part we needed from advanced using his discount as well as discussed helping our family with some other things. He was very affordable and was there within 10 minutes upon us calling for a tow. I've never had such good service. Thank you Ricky and Pitts Towing

reviews.author: Kalynn Wiley
reviews.text: Tried calling when my Jeep left me stranded in the middle of the road. Whomever answered the phone was very rude. Don’t have a 24/7 tow company if you don’t want a 0600 call asking for a tow.

reviews.author: Kerri Goodson
reviews.text: Drivers were courteous and punctual. However watch your vehicle when they load it! The tech who picked my car up to tow it removed a plastic cover from my front bumper (to access the hook to tow it). I got my car from the repair shop they towed it to & noticed a hole on the bumper where that piece was before they towed my car. I did reach out to the owners. They said they contacted the tech, who told them it was left in my car's seat, however it was not. I will now have to order a replacement piece from Ebay at my own expense because of them losing it. I realize it isn't a huge piece but I feel like they should not have lied about placing it in my car when they clearly did not. It is so very noticeable & now after a hefty repair bill I have to replace this as well.

reviews.author: Kimberly Cutshaw
reviews.text: These guys are exceptional! I was doing daily chores and my truck wouldn't go in gear. These guys are awesome. After less than 5 minutes Mr. Joe slide under the truck and zip tie and had it going in gear. I will recommend them in a heartbeat! Blessed to have them there for me.!!

reviews.author: Penny Rolfes
reviews.text: Had to use their towing service and they were on time and efficient. We've also had our vehicle inspected there and they were friendly and efficient. We will go back for our future inspections.

reviews.author: Jonathan Morgan
reviews.text: Pitts towing is hands down the best at what they do. When you need a honest company to haul your vehicle. They are who you can count on to fulfill your expectations. They also offer a number of other services. From tires to servicing and repairing your vehicle.)l

reviews.author: Daniel P
reviews.text: Broke down in town on a Saturday. Ricky the driver was awesome. Got there within 5 minutes, picked up our broken down pickup, and dropped us off at the only open shop in town a few minutes later. Very reasonable rates too. Thank you sir.

reviews.author: Charles Green
reviews.text: Great job diagnosing an issue with my car. Very reasonable and told me how to get it repaired since it was not his wheelhouse. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Brittany Yangilmau
reviews.text: Wish I could give them 100 stars. Showed up in one helluva storm 30 minutes earlier than they were supposed to and did not complain about having to work from the side of the interstate in a down pour and extremely hazardous situation. I wish I had gotten the names of the 2 guys that helped me yesterday with my motorcycle because I want them again if I ever find myself in need of a tow. Really outstanding men! PITTS, I hope you pay them well because they are the best representatives for your business! Big thanks to them!

reviews.author: Hunter Fiedler
reviews.text: Cecil was amazing. Had a flat this morning at 7:30 and he came within 40 minutes and it was a 30 minute drive to get me. They are very affordable and Cecil is an amazing guy. Would recommend 10x over again to anyone. Amazing guys.

reviews.author: Tashauna Gravely
reviews.text: Great people !!! We met Joe and his wife while out at the flea market today. Our Jeep broke down (battery) didn't know why at the time.. They stopped to help us jump it off. Couldn’t ask for better people. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Danielle Mitchell
reviews.text: My husband went to get his truck inspected and 3 men that worked there told my husband 3 different places to park making him feel stupid and even the owner making his hand gestures on signs or whatever check with your minions telling him where to park. My husband said yall lost our respect and us as a customer.

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.text: I was absolutely blown away at my experience with Pitts towing. We live in franklin. My wife's car broke down in Clyde. Not only was Pitts $1000 less than the other companies we called. But the driver offered to wait with my wife until I got there to pick her up. They are professional, reliable, reasonable, and respectful. I could not have possibly anticipated the interaction going as well as it did.

reviews.author: Connie Gregory
reviews.text: Joe is without a doubt the nicest human being I have ever met. I'm from out of state and had an accident on the interstate there, and he made extraordinary efforts to help me get my possessions out of my totaled car before I left to go home over 4 hours away. It is the best customer service anyone could ever ask for.

reviews.author: Ray Shaw
reviews.text: Pitts Towing was dispatched by our insurance company. The driver let us know he was on his way. When he arrived he was friendly, helpful, and professional. He was aware we had my wife’s service dog, and informed us the dog could ride in the tow truck with us. When we arrived home he off loaded our Jeep, informed us that he would file all the needed paperwork with our insurance company. Joe is a first class tow operator. We would not hesitate to use Pitts Towing again.

reviews.author: Lois Ray-Paliulis
reviews.text: Truck driver just pulled into passing lane, turned all his white lights on and applied his brakes. DANGEROUS DRIVER!!! Not a company I would use!

reviews.author: Anastasia Grace
reviews.text: I was so appreciative of the prompt service sent to me via my insurance. I stupidly locked my keys in my car- first time ever !!! And the service was fast and efficient and the gentleman was very professional and positive and I’m afraid I didn’t get to express my gratitude enough from the stress of the day but thank you for helping me all the way in Franklin!! Edit* I believe it was Bob who came to my rescue so thank you Bob !!!

reviews.author: Mike EZ
reviews.text: Pitts towing helped us after we had an accident and my car was disabled along I-40. They were friendly, courteous, and professional. They took time to sympathize with our situation and helped ensure our comfort until our ride could arrive at their shop. After we left, they kept us up to date until the vehicle was removed from their property. We don't live nearby, but if we did we would definitely use Pitts again.

reviews.author: Adrien Raines
reviews.text: Bobby is the MAN. Got locked out of my car while it was snowing, within 15 minutes he was there and had my doors unlocked. Absolutely would recommend Pitts if you’re in Waynesville, no one else in the area will give you efficient service like Pitts. 10/10

reviews.author: Paul Brooks
reviews.text: Great guys. Was left hanging for 4 hrs by another tow company. Reached out to these guys and they were there in 15 minutes. Towed my truck and did it at a great price.

reviews.author: J Arthur
reviews.text: My boss had his car towed from his shop to the mechanic. Driver showed up in 10 minutes. We loaded up the car and was on our way. Very professional. Definitely would recommend.

reviews.author: Patricia Weber
reviews.text: A very polite young man came to tow my car to the dealer this morning. He was so nice and it wasn’t an easy spot to get it on his truck. Being on a steep incline he managed to get the car up on the truck. Thank you

reviews.author: Amanda Ray
reviews.text: We had AMAZING service! Our car broke down while driving thru town from out of town. Pitts towed us and replaced our starter in a matter of minutes. Fantastic service!

reviews.author: Mike Bayliss
reviews.text: I had to call from out of state, and the dispatch was curtious, kind, and understanding. They handled the situation in a prompt, professional manner, and I would recommend their service to anyone in need. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Scotty Cherryholmes
reviews.text: I always get my two cars inspected here. On my last visit I got an oil change too. It was all done quickly. Very friendly service.

reviews.author: Fred McKinnon
reviews.text: Great Service! He went above and beyond to tow my sons truck. Was early and helped us get the truck to the right location.

reviews.author: Ellah Jaynes
reviews.text: One of the best place to go in Haywood county especially for inspection. Guys are always friendly, professional, and will finish the service in a timely manner.

reviews.author: Melanie Angell
reviews.text: I was amazed with how quickly they had a tow truck to me! The driver was extremely friendly and helpful!

reviews.author: Matt Melton
reviews.text: Excellent service, great crew that know what they're doing and more than happy to help out, and at a great price.
